rationale: Replaced the broad, partly ignored nine-axis generator with a deterministic five-axis sparse grammar, exact observer, strict self_check, repeated-color counterbranch, and RULE_HASH pin.
summary: For every nonzero source pixel, paint its complete row and complete column with that source color. A cell reached by exactly one distinct source color keeps that color; a cell reached by two or more different source colors becomes red (2). Repeated sources of the same color do not make their mutual crossings red.
